'''Phillip Alan Griffith''' (born December 29, 1940) is a mathematician and [[professor emeritus]] at [[University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign]] who works on commutative algebra and ring theory.  He received his PhD from the [[University of Houston]] in 1968.<ref name="Home page">{{cite web|url=http://www.math.uiuc.edu/People/griffith.html|title=Phillip Griffith|work=Department of Mathematics|publisher=University of Illinois|accessdate=November 8, 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403081342/http://www.math.uiuc.edu/People/griffith.html|archive-date=April 3, 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref>  Griffith is the [[editor-in-chief]] of the ''[[Illinois Journal of Mathematics]]''<ref name="Home page" />  In 1971, Griffith received a [[Sloan Fellowship]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.math.illinois.edu/People/facultyhonors.html|title=Faculty Honors|work=Mathematics|publisher=University of Illinois|accessdate=November 8, 2012|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130215002400/http://www.math.illinois.edu/People/facultyhonors.html|archivedate=February 15, 2013|df=mdy-all}}</ref>
